newsitem.title: USA: High cotton prices trigger import quota - USDA.
newsitem.headline: High cotton prices trigger import quota - USDA.

text.p: High cotton prices have triggered another special quota permitting entry of 44,522,887 kilograms (98,156,244 lbs), the U.S. Department of Agriculture said Thursday.
The quota, being established on Dec 11, 1996, applies to cotton purchased not later than March 10, 1997 and entered into the United States not later than June 8, 1997, USDA said.
The quota amount is for the period August 1996 through October 1996.
